key_evidence_spans: bloody diarrhea occurring up to seven times a day
bilateral lower abdominal tenderness but no peritonitis
Sigmoidoscopy showed continuous diffuse granular and friable mucosa to the ascending colon
Biopsy findings: Moderately active colitis with cryptitis and crypt abscesses
Colonic biopsy sample showing focal goblet cell depletion, acute and chronic inflammation in the lamina propria, cryptitis, and crypt abscesses
Stool cultures were negative, and Clostridium difficile toxin was not present
Ultrasound: Showed mild thickening of the wall of the right colon
